jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and scale the foundational data platform that powers analytics, real-time decisioning, and operational intelligence across Alo. This role is for an experienced builder who has delivered production-grade data systems across event ingestion, transformation, modeling, and serving and knows how to make them reusable, reliable, and scalable. You will build and extend the batch and real-time systems teams rely on to ingest, process, and act on data, enabling marketing automation, inventory intelligence, and order fulfillment visibility. jobs.title: Senior Digital Designer
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW At ALO, digital is one of the most important expressions of our brand. As a Senior Digital Designer, you’ll help shape how ALO comes to life across our digital ecosystem, creating elevated, intuitive, and high-performing experiences that balance brand storytelling with functionality. This role is for a strong digital thinker and designer who can translate creative direction into thoughtful, polished experiences across site, landing pages, campaigns, and other digital touchpoints. You’ll collaborate across creative and cross-functional teams to bring ideas from concept through launch while maintaining a consistent, premium brand experience. RESPONSIBILITIES Design elevated digital experiences across ALO’s website, landing pages, launches, campaigns, and key brand moments. Translate brand and campaign creative into thoughtful, mobile-first digital experiences. Develop concepts and layouts that balance storytelling, usability, hierarchy, and performance. Own projects from initial concept through final production, QA, and launch. Adapt creative thoughtfully across desktop and mobile, considering the needs of each experience rather than simply resizing layouts. Build and evolve scalable templates and systems that improve consistency and efficiency across digital. Partner cross-functionally to understand business needs and translate them into strong creative solutions. jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW The Senior Manager of Retail Marketing is a senior leader responsible for defining and driving ALO's global retail marketing strategy, with direct execution ownership across the United States and Canada. jobs.title: Senior Technical Designer, Sweaters
jobs.description_text: Overview: The Senior Technical Designer, Sweaters is a lead role in the garment fit and tailoring arena of the brand. Your technical expertise will be used in fitting base size models. You will also fit full size runs and be responsible for correcting the fit in multiple ways from Proto 1 all the way to PP (Pre-Production Fit.) Extensive experience in the fit room is a must. After fitting, draping, and tailoring Alo designs on our standard models, the data derived from the fittings will be used to effectively communicate to the technical garment changes/ updates to various vendors we collaborate with globally. jobs.title: Visual Lead - Avalon
jobs.description_text: OBJECTIVE The Visual Lead is responsible for achieving store sales & maximizing profitability through Visual Merchandising in partnership with the Management Team. The Visual Lead will work closely with Operations & Visual Managers in initiating, delegating work, and providing feedback to the team to achieve optimal results supporting total store operations. Duties require constant movement in and around the store, including the sales floor and back of house. When not actively assisting guests, this position takes initiative to perform other tasks, as needed, to keep store clean, safe, inviting and operating efficiently. Visual Leader Manage execution of key operational functions including shipment, receiving and processing, reverse transfers, sales floor recovery, intra-day sales floor replenishment, floor set updates, and supply management Maintains strategic product presentation and merchandising by ensuring product recovery, restock, destock, and making visual merchandising change in accordance with directive and with partnership of the Visual Manager Effectively plans visual floor changes with the management team through payroll management and adapting the zone and visual support to the needs of the business Executes and maintains visual direction from planning through executing to meeting company expectations, budgets, timeline Utilizes reporting tools in partnership with management to identify business opportunities with product placement, outfitting, and stock levels.

jobs.description_text: The Role: We're hiring one of the first software engineers on our electro-optical team. Today that means long-range EO/IR sensors. This is a software engineering role first. You don't need to be a camera or computer vision specialist. You do need to be an excellent engineer who is curious about physical systems and understands how real sensors behave: they drift, they disagree with each other, and a field test doesn't care what the simulation said. You'll join a small, elite team that takes its own work into the field. You'll test live, change code live, and see how it holds up on the next flight. The capabilities you build will push the frontier of what these systems can do, and few engineers anywhere get to work this close to the hardware, the mission and the result. We're also changing how we build software. The aim is to take a feature or a new capability and develop as much of it as possible without real hardware, then push it up the chain: through simulation, through hardware in the loop, and on to full end-to-end tests in the real world. Simulation will keep improving, but real hardware will always have the final say. jobs.description_text: Dark Wolf is seeking an IT Strategist to support our mission by driving strategy and execution for TS/SCI networks and systems, SIPRNet VDI network and systems architectures, and Cross Domain Solutions (CDS) for commercial SCIFs. The primary objective of this role is to oversee the strategic implementation of the Commercial Wide Area Network (CWAN) to streamline Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) access for the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). The Senior IT Strategist will guide the paradigm shift from a government-funded infrastructure to a commercial fee-for-service model. The IT strategist will lead the Classified Infrastructure as a Service (CIaaS) Pilot, focusing on rapid capability delivery. The core scope involves reducing the current 12 to 24-month site onboarding timeline to under 3 months by transitioning to a contractor-delivered minimum viable product. jobs.title: Maintenance Technician - Cortland at Coalton
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As a Maintenance Technician, you ensure the community remains safe, functional, and well‑maintained by diagnosing and repairing a wide range of building and apartment systems. You provide timely, high‑quality service to residents, support preventative maintenance programs, and help preserve the property’s physical assets through consistent care and attention. Diagnose, repair, and resolve maintenance issues involving electrical, plumbing, HVAC systems, appliances, flooring, stairs, railings, and other building components. Correct unsafe conditions such as broken lights, damaged gates, open holes, or other hazards, ensuring issues are addressed quickly and safely. Support asset preservation by monitoring and reporting on the condition of building and security systems such as automatic doors and surveillance cameras. Schedule and perform preventative maintenance on HVAC units, equipment, and building systems to improve performance and reduce downtime. Maintain appropriate inventory of supplies and spare parts to ensure timely completion of work orders. Respond to on ‑ call rotations and emergency maintenance situations, assisting with both resident and property needs. Provide friendly, professional service when interacting with residents and team members. Document completed work and report recurring issues or safety concerns to your supervisor. Qualifications EPA certification required (Type I, II, or Universal). 1–3+ years of experience in maintenance, facilities
